sectionDescription: Using the right study techniques and managing your time properly can easily double your learning speed.

tips.title: Active Recall
tips.desc: Instead of just passively rereading text, quiz yourself on the concepts. Testing your memory keeps your brain highly engaged and helps retain data longer.

tips.title: Feynman Technique
tips.desc: Try explaining a complex topic in the simplest terms possible, as if you are teaching it to a 10-year-old child. This quickly exposes any gaps in your understanding.

tips.title: Spaced Repetition
tips.desc: Review what you learned at increasing intervals (e.g., after 1 day, 3 days, and then 7 days). This systematically shifts the information into your long-term memory.

tips.title: Pomodoro Technique
tips.desc: Work or study with 100% focus for 25 minutes, then take a short 5-minute break to refresh your mind. Repeat this cycle to maintain long-lasting energy.

tips.title: Eat the Frog
tips.desc: Identify your most difficult or important task of the day and finish it first thing in the morning. Completing it early removes stress for the rest of your day.
